purpose: Response-blind schema qualification using only official USGS/ScienceBase metadata after v1 stopped before response-body access.
next_gate_rule: Only if official metadata identifies an unambiguous stable sampling unit, year field, region/site field, and Zostera percent-cover field may a parser be frozen before opening CSV rows. Otherwise v2 stops pre-response.
no_rescue: Do not infer column semantics from data values.
Do not open the response CSV to discover schema.
Do not change the ecological endpoint or estimability minima from v1 based on metadata convenience.
